summary: npx <tool> fails for every agent in this cloud session — npm rejects node v26.8.0-alpha.0.0.0 against the repo's devEngines.runtime ^26, so npx coherence/oxfmt/oxlint all error EBADDEVENGINES
evidence: npm error EBADDEVENGINES Invalid semver version 'v26.8.0-alpha.0.0.0' does not match '^26' for 'runtime'. Three separate subagents lost their decision journal to this and reported it independently. Workaround: ./node_modules/.bin/<tool> from the repo root. Now documented under Runtime Gotchas in AGENTS.md
